messages:
maria: hey team — weird parity bug in samplekit. Node SDK + jsonMode strict + fncall tools: after a retry the function_call.arguments becomes a JSON string that itself contains a JSON string. schema validators choke.

sam: can you paste repro steps and a log snippet?

maria: repro: Node SDK v2.3.1, jsonMode: { strict: true }, tool returns { items: [{ id: 7, tag: "ok" }] }. Simulate transient 401 to trigger retry. outgoing body we logged shows:
```
{ function_call: { name: "ingest_items", arguments: "{\"items\":\"{\\\"id\\\":7,\\\"tag\\\":\"ok\\\"}"}" } }
```

emily: that definitely smells like double-JSON.stringify. odd that Python sampleapp keeps the object shape.

jordan: probable root cause: retry layer stores body as string for logging/cache and then JSON.stringify's the whole payload when reconstructing the request. we also changed rawBody handling last sprint which could be related.

lee: short-term DX workaround: run a lightweight helper in samplekit like `const args = parseToolArgs(resp);` which detects a stringified-JSON and returns a parsed object before schema validation. add to quickstart.

sam: i'll open a patch in sdk-core to avoid re-stringifying function_call.arguments on retry. plan: when rebuilding request use the original parsed representation if available; add unit tests that simulate auth/network failures and assert argument shape preserved.

maria: created ticket DEVEX-1499 for "node sdk retry path double-serializes fncall args" (assignee: sam). i'll add a failing integration test in CI and update onboarding docs to call out the caveat until fix ships.

lee: additional safer approach: on validation path, if `typeof function_call.arguments === 'string' && jsonMode.strict`, attempt `JSON.parse` once and emit telemetry event `fncall.retry_parse_attempt` with success/failure so teams can see prevalence.

sam: agree. will add opt-in compat flag `retryParseFnArgs: true` default false so we don't surprise existing customers, and log a clear deprecation/changelog entry.

maria: also adding a short note to docs/SDK-quirks and samplekit quickstart. cc @all. thanks! :thumbsup:

devex-bot: created DEVEX-1499: "node sdk retry double-serialize fncall args"
